name: Manganic-Serac
description: Heat is the local god. Fissures glow along every fault line, the air tastes of sulfur past geothermal vent fields, and by dark the ground itself still glows faintly, like a banked furnace.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
